zone.description: Bridge interfaces owned by the Docker daemon (docker0 and any user-defined bridge networks). Docker manages its own forwarding/NAT rules ahead of this zone in the FORWARD chain, so published container ports keep working; this zone's REJECT target is defense in depth against a container reaching a host-only service that isn't meant to be container-reachable, and against any container traffic that isn't covered by Docker's own chains. No services/ports are opened here - Docker punches its own holes for published ports.
